paragraphs.en: When inference demand exceeds available compute capacity, model providers must decide which requests should be served first. Users have different tolerances for delay from an LLM API, but current priority pricing schemes compress these differences into coarse fixed-price service tiers. We design an inference auction that allows users to bid for faster service. Our auction allocates priority in an economically efficient way without sacrificing latency, and we develop fast algorithms for implementing prices that incentivize truthful bidding. We also design an autobidding agent for our inference auction, where users specify an inference budget and the autobidder dynamically adjusts its bids over time to maximize user utility subject to the budget constraint. Experiments validate the practicality of our auction: it increases system welfare while maintaining the cache utilization and latency advantages of SGLang, a state-of-the-art inference serving framework.
paragraphs.zh: 当推理需求超过可用计算能力时，模型提供商必须决定哪些请求应优先处理。 用户对 LLM API 延迟的容忍度各不相同，但当前的优先级定价方案将这些差异压缩为粗略的固定价格服务层级。 我们设计了一种推理拍卖机制，允许用户为更快的服务出价。 我们的拍卖机制能够以经济高效的方式分配优先级，同时不牺牲低延迟性，并且我们开发了快速算法来实现能够激励真实出价的定价策略。 我们还为我们的推理拍卖设计了一个自动出价智能体：用户只需指定推理预算，该自动出价器便会随时间动态调整出价，在满足预算约束的前提下最大化用户效用。 实验验证了我们的拍卖机制的实用性：它在保持 SGLang（一个先进的推理服务框架）的缓存利用率和低延迟优势的同时，提升了系统整体福利。

paragraphs.en: Large-scale LLM inference requires allocation of shared compute resources across different users’ requests. During periods of heavy traffic, model providers need to determine which requests to serve first, and how much to charge for faster service. Users can differ substantially in their willingness to pay for earlier service. For example, an interactive request may be sensitive to delays that are inconsequential for a background job. Today, most major model providers allocate priority through a small number of fixed-price service tiers (typically two or three), with higher-paying requests receiving priority over lower-paying ones during times of high traffic [ 6 , 3 , 38 , 23 , 49 , e.g.,] . These coarse tiers give users limited scope to express their latency preferences, and as a result, priority is allocated in an economically inefficient way.
paragraphs.zh: 大规模 LLM 推理需要在不同用户的请求之间分配共享的计算资源。 在高流量时段，模型提供商需要决定优先处理哪些请求，以及为更快的服务收取多少费用。 用户对提前获得服务的支付意愿可能存在显著差异。 例如，交互式请求可能对延迟非常敏感，而这种延迟对于后台任务而言却无关紧要。 目前，大多数主要模型提供商通过少数几个固定价格的服务等级（通常为两到三个）来分配优先级，在高流量时段，支付费用较高的请求会优先于支付费用较低的处理 [6, 3, 38, 23, 49, 例如]。 这些粗略的服务等级使用户难以充分表达其对延迟的偏好，因此优先级的分配方式在经济上并不高效。

paragraphs.en: The design of a more expressive and efficient market for inference priority raises new challenges that are absent from conventional queuing systems and transaction-fee markets. Modern inference engines process prompts with the same prefix by reusing the key-value (KV) cache across their shared prefix, so the time it takes to serve a request depends on which requests have already been served [ 52 , 34 , 41 , e.g.,] . For example, interrupting a batch of requests that all share a long common prefix to serve unrelated requests may cause the common prefix to be evicted from the KV cache, disrupting cache reuse and harming request throughput. Serving that same batch of common-prefix requests contiguously instead will generally yield improved throughput due to better cache utilization. This form of prefix-aware scheduling and KV cache management is implemented in state-of-the-art inference serving frameworks such as SGLang [ 52 ] , leading to significant latency and throughput gains. A good market design should not sacrifice these performance gains.
paragraphs.zh: 设计一个更具表现力且效率更高的推理优先级市场，会引发一些传统排队系统和交易费用市场所没有的新挑战。 现代推理引擎通过在其共享前缀上重复使用键值（KV）缓存来处理具有相同前缀的提示，因此处理请求所需的时间取决于哪些请求已经得到处理 [ 52 , 34 , 41 , 例如 ] 。 例如，为了处理无关的请求而中断一批共享长公共前缀的请求，可能导致该公共前缀被逐出 KV 缓存，从而破坏缓存重用并降低请求吞吐量。 相反，连续处理这批具有公共前缀的请求通常能因更高效的缓存利用而提升吞吐量。 这种基于前缀感知的调度和 KV 缓存管理方式已集成到 SGLang [ 52 ] 等最先进的推理服务框架中，从而显著降低了延迟并提升了吞吐量。 一个优秀的市场设计不应牺牲这些性能优势。

paragraphs.en: Inference Auction Design (Section 2 and Section 3 ). We develop the first inference auction, a way for LLM providers to prioritize requests by letting users bid for faster service. Each bid represents the user’s reported value for moving a request from the back of the scheduling queue to the front, with value increasing linearly as the request moves earlier in the schedule. Our goal is to maximize social welfare—the total value users derive from their assigned priorities—while retaining cache optimality. A key aspect of our inference auction design is to constrain the resulting schedule of requests to be a depth-first-search (DFS) schedule , that is, it must correspond to a DFS traversal of the radix tree of requests (a tree in which requests that share a prompt prefix share a path from the root). Inference auctions corresponding to such DFS schedules maximize KV cache hit rate due to optimal prefix sharing. We show that the welfare-maximizing DFS schedule corresponds to the DFS traversal that orders a node’s children by average bid across requests in their subtrees, and can therefore be computed very efficiently. We pair our scheduling rule with Vickrey–Clarke–Groves (VCG) payments that incentivize truthful bidding. Computing VCG payments naively requires recomputing an optimal schedule for each user, causing a quadratic worst-case dependence on the number of requests. We develop an algorithm that computes all payments in quasilinear run-time by decomposing each user’s welfare externality into local changes along the radix tree.
paragraphs.zh: 推理拍卖设计（第 2 节和第 3 节）。 我们提出了首个推理拍卖机制，这是一种让大型语言模型提供商通过允许用户为更快服务出价来优先处理请求的方法。 每次出价代表用户对将请求从调度队列末尾移至队首所报告的价值，且该价值会随着请求在调度中的位置提前而线性增加。 我们的目标是最大化社会福祉——即用户从其分配到的优先级中获得的总价值——同时保持缓存的最优性。 我们推理拍卖设计的一个关键方面是，将由此产生的请求调度限制为深度优先搜索（DFS）调度，也就是说，它必须对应于请求根树（一棵共享提示前缀的请求共享从根节点出发的路径的树）的深度优先遍历。 与此类 DFS 调度相对应的推理拍卖能够因最优的前缀共享而最大化 KV 缓存命中率。 我们证明了，能最大化社会福祉的 DFS 调度对应于这样一种深度优先遍历：它根据各子树中请求的平均出价对节点的子节点进行排序，因此可以非常高效地计算出来。 我们将我们的调度规则与维克瑞-克拉克-格罗夫斯（VCG）支付机制相结合，以激励用户真实出价。 若采用朴素方法计算 VCG 支付，则需要为每个用户重新计算最优调度，导致最坏情况下的时间复杂度与请求数量呈二次方关系。 我们开发了一种算法，通过将每个用户的社会福祉外部性分解为根树上的局部变化，以准线性运行时间计算出所有支付。

paragraphs.en: Autobidding Agents for Inference Auctions (Section 4 ). Inference users typically submit many requests over time and must manage their inference budget. Even when truthful reporting is optimal in each auction in isolation, users still need to choose how aggressively to bid across requests so that their inference budget is spent where it is most valuable. To address this, we design an autobidding agent that adjusts a user’s bids over time to maximize their cumulative utility, subject to a budget constraint. Our autobidding algorithm scales each request’s value by a multiplier and adjusts this multiplier over time using gradient descent. We show that this strategy achieves O ⁡ ( T ) O(\sqrt{T}) regret relative to the optimal-in-hindsight bidding policy on a sequence of T T inference auctions. We also characterize the welfare loss when users have different pacing multipliers: we show that welfare only decreases when these differences reverse the ordering of requests in the DFS schedule, and we bound the resulting inefficiency by the variation in pacing multipliers across the radix subtrees.
paragraphs.zh: 推理拍卖中的自动出价智能体（第 4 节）。 推理用户通常会随时间提交大量请求，并且必须管理自己的推理预算。 即使在每次独立的拍卖中如实报告是最优选择，用户仍然需要决定如何激进地跨请求出价，以确保推理预算被用于价值最高的地方。 为了解决这个问题，我们设计了一种自动出价智能体，它会根据时间动态调整用户的出价，以在预算约束下最大化其累积效用。 我们的自动出价算法通过一个乘数来缩放每个请求的价值，并利用梯度下降法随时间调整该乘数。 我们证明，在 T 个推理拍卖的序列中，该策略相对于事后最优出价策略的遗憾值为 O ⁡ ( T ) O(\sqrt{T})。 我们还分析了当用户具有不同节奏乘数时的福利损失：我们发现，只有当这些差异改变了深度优先调度中请求的顺序时，福利才会下降，并且我们将由此产生的低效率限制在根子树间节奏乘数的差异范围内。

paragraphs.en: Experiments (Section 5 ). We implement our inference auction as a scheduling layer in front of an unmodified SGLang server and evaluate it across several workloads with various shared prefix structures. Compared to a bid-blind, cache-optimal request ordering, our mechanism improves overall welfare by 12–18.6% under i.i.d. request valuations and up to 100 % 100\% when valuations are non-i.i.d., all while leaving cache hit rate and average time-to-first-token virtually unchanged. Simultaneously, we find that our mechanism enjoys ∼ ​ 80 % \mathord{\sim}80\% of the welfare of the unconstrained schedule ordered by decreasing bids. In contrast, this unconstrained schedule sharply reduces cache hit rates, which results in an increase in average latency by as much as 12 × 12\times .
paragraphs.zh: 实验（第 5 节）。 我们将推理拍卖实现为一个调度层，置于未经修改的 SGLang 服务器之前，并在具有不同共享前缀结构的多种工作负载中对其进行了评估。 与不考虑出价、仅优化缓存的请求排序相比，在独立同分布的请求估值下，我们的机制将整体福利提升了 12–18.6%；而在估值非独立同分布时，这一提升甚至可达 100 % 100\%，同时几乎未改变缓存命中率与平均首次词元生成时间。 同时我们发现，我们的机制实现了按出价降序排列的无约束调度方案约 ∼ ​ 80 % \mathord{\sim}80\% 的福利水平。 相比之下，这种无约束调度方案会显著降低缓存命中率，导致平均延迟最多增加 12 × 12\times 。

paragraphs.en: Serving an autoregressive language model has two stages. During prefill , the model processes a request’s prompt and stores its keys and values in the KV cache. During decoding , it generates output tokens while reusing the cached keys and values. Modern inference engines interleave the two stages across requests, typically prioritizing the decode steps of requests already in progress. Our mechanism determines the order in which queued requests are admitted for prefill.
paragraphs.zh: 为自回归语言模型提供服务包含两个阶段。 在预填充阶段，模型会处理请求的提示，并将其键值对存储在 KV 缓存中。 在解码阶段，模型会利用已缓存的键值对生成输出词元。 现代推理引擎会在不同请求之间交替执行这两个阶段，通常会优先处理已在进行中的请求的解码步骤。 我们的机制决定了队列中请求被接纳进行预填充的顺序。

sents.en: Serving an autoregressive language model has two stages.
sents.zh: 为自回归语言模型提供服务包含两个阶段。

sents.en: During prefill , the model processes a request’s prompt and stores its keys and values in the KV cache.
sents.zh: 在预填充阶段，模型会处理请求的提示，并将其键值对存储在 KV 缓存中。

sents.en: During decoding , it generates output tokens while reusing the cached keys and values.
sents.zh: 在解码阶段，模型会利用已缓存的键值对生成输出词元。

sents.en: Modern inference engines interleave the two stages across requests, typically prioritizing the decode steps of requests already in progress.
sents.zh: 现代推理引擎会在不同请求之间交替执行这两个阶段，通常会优先处理已在进行中的请求的解码步骤。

sents.en: Our mechanism determines the order in which queued requests are admitted for prefill.
sents.zh: 我们的机制决定了队列中请求被接纳进行预填充的顺序。

paragraphs.en: The KV cache entries for a prompt prefix can be reused by other requests which share that prefix, reducing prefill computation. Because cache capacity is limited, this reuse depends on the request scheduling order: processing requests with a long shared prefix consecutively can avoid evicting and recomputing their common entries. The inference engine SGLang [ 52 ] puts this principle into practice by storing shared token prefixes in a radix tree and scheduling requests in the order of a DFS traversal of that tree, which is a longest-prefix-match order and is cache-optimal. A key aspect of our auction design is to allow bids to only affect the ordering of children in a DFS traversal of the request radix tree. This ensures that no matter the precise economics of the auction (e.g., schedules, payments, incentives), we maintain the cache efficiency of prefix-aware scheduling. We now formally introduce the elements of the auction environment.
paragraphs.zh: 提示前缀的 KV 缓存条目可以被共享该前缀的其他请求重复使用，从而减少预填充计算。 由于缓存容量有限，这种重复使用取决于请求的调度顺序：连续处理具有较长共享前缀的请求，可以避免将其共同条目驱逐并重新计算。 推理引擎 SGLang [ 52 ] 通过将共享的标记前缀存储在基数树中，并按照深度优先搜索（DFS）遍历该树的顺序调度请求，将这一原则付诸实践；这种顺序属于最长前缀匹配顺序，并且是缓存最优的。 我们拍卖设计的一个关键方面是，允许出价仅影响请求基数树在深度优先搜索（DFS）遍历中子节点的排序。 这确保了无论拍卖的具体经济机制如何（例如，调度、支付、激励），我们都能保持前缀感知调度的缓存效率。 我们现在正式介绍拍卖环境的各个要素。

paragraphs.en: Requests and Scheduling Batches. We consider a setting where a model provider is serving requests to a single LLM on one inference worker. Requests arrive asynchronously and are periodically grouped into scheduling batches of n n queued requests. We treat the formation of these batches as exogenous: our mechanism determines the relative prefill priority of requests within a batch, but not which requests enter the batch. 1 1 1 In practice, batches would be formed only during times of high traffic when requests start to queue.
paragraphs.zh: 请求与调度批次的处理。 我们考虑这样一种场景：模型提供商通过一个推理工作器为单个大型语言模型提供服务请求。 请求异步到达，并定期被分组为包含 n 个排队请求的调度批次。 我们将这些批次的形成视为外生因素：我们的机制决定批次内请求的相对预填充优先级，但不决定哪些请求会进入该批次。1 1 1 实际上，只有在高流量时期、请求开始排队时才会形成批次。

sents.en: Requests and Scheduling Batches.
sents.zh: 请求与调度批次的处理。

paragraphs.en: Fractional priority provides a simple rank-based proxy for queueing delay and the resulting time-to-first-token (TTFT). Modeling value as being linear in fractional priority is a design choice to keep the bidding language simple : users only need to report how much they value moving a request from the back of the scheduling batch to the front, rather than specify a potentially complex value function over TTFT. Our experiments show that bidding according to fractional priority leads to schedules that closely track realized TTFT, supporting fractional priority as a practical proxy for latency.
paragraphs.zh: 分数优先级提供了一种基于排名的简单代理指标，用于衡量排队延迟以及由此产生的首个令牌到达时间（TTFT）。 将价值建模为与分数优先级呈线性关系是一种设计选择，旨在保持竞价语言的简洁性：用户只需报告他们希望将请求从调度批次的末尾移至开头所愿意付出的价值，而无需指定一个可能复杂的、基于 TTFT 的价值函数。 我们的实验表明，按照分数优先级进行竞价所生成的调度能够紧密跟踪实际实现的 TTFT，这支持了将分数优先级用作延迟实用代理指标的观点。

paragraphs.en: Given a radix tree 𝖳 \mathsf{T} , an inference auction consists of (1) a scheduling rule A : ℝ + n → 𝒟 ⁡ ( 𝖳 ) A:\mathbb{R}_{+}^{n}\rightarrow\mathcal{D}(\mathsf{T}) mapping bids to DFS schedules and (2) a payment rule p : ℝ + n → ℝ + m p:\mathbb{R}_{+}^{n}\rightarrow\mathbb{R}_{+}^{m} mapping bids to payments, where p i ( 𝐛 1 : m ) p_{i}(\mathbf{b}_{1:m}) is the payment charged to user i i .
paragraphs.zh: 给定一个基数树 𝖳 \mathsf{T}，推理拍卖包括（1）一个调度规则 A : ℝ + n → 𝒟 ⁡ ( 𝖳 ) A:\mathbb{R}_{+}^{n}\rightarrow\mathcal{D}(\mathsf{T})，它将出价映射到深度优先搜索（DFS）调度；以及（2）一个支付规则 p : ℝ + n → ℝ + m p:\mathbb{R}_{+}^{n}\rightarrow\mathbb{R}_{+}^{m}，它将出价映射到支付，其中 p i ( 𝐛 1 : m ) p_{i}(\mathbf{b}_{1:m}) 是向用户 i i 收取的支付金额。

paragraphs.en: Any inference auction enjoys optimal cache utilization by Theorem 3.1 of Zheng et al. [52] .
paragraphs.zh: 根据 Zheng 等人 [52] 的定理 3.1，任何推理拍卖都能实现最优缓存利用率。

paragraphs.en: We make the standard assumption that users have quasilinear utility, so a user with true values 𝐯 i \mathbf{v}_{i} obtains utility V i ( A ( 𝐛 1 : m ) ) − p i ( 𝐛 1 : m ) V_{i}(A(\mathbf{b}_{1:m}))-p_{i}(\mathbf{b}_{1:m}) in an inference auction with scheduling rule A A and payment rule p p . Our goal in the sequel is to design an inference auction that maximizes welfare over 𝒟 ⁡ ( 𝖳 ) \mathcal{D}(\mathsf{T}) while incentivizing truthful bidding. A simple symmetry argument shows that the welfare loss due to restricting to 𝒟 ⁡ ( 𝖳 ) \mathcal{D}(\mathsf{T}) is no more than 50 % 50\% . 2 2 2 At the same time, the welfare-maximizing DFS schedule can improve significantly over an arbitrary schedule in 𝒟 ⁡ ( 𝖳 ) \mathcal{D}(\mathsf{T}) . As an example, consider the setting where one request has value v ⋆ > 0 v^{\star}>0 and shares no common prefix with the n − 1 n-1 other requests, each of which has value 0 0 and a common shared prefix. A uniformly random DFS schedule would obtain zero welfare with probability 1 / 2 1/2 , whereas the optimal DFS schedule always achieves the maximum welfare v ⋆ v^{\star} .
paragraphs.zh: 我们采用标准假设，即用户具有拟线性效用。因此，在推理拍卖中，真实价值为 𝐯 i \mathbf{v}_{i} 的用户，在调度规则为 A A、支付规则为 p p 的情况下，获得的效用为 V i ( A ( 𝐛 1 : m ) ) − p i ( 𝐛 1 : m ) V_{i}(A(\mathbf{b}_{1:m}))-p_{i}(\mathbf{b}_{1:m})。 接下来，我们的目标是设计一种推理拍卖机制，在激励真实报价的同时，最大化 𝒟 ⁡ ( 𝖳 ) \mathcal{D}(\mathsf{T}) 上的社会福利。 一个简单的对称性论证表明，限制在 𝒟 ⁡ ( 𝖳 ) \mathcal{D}(\mathsf{T}) 内所导致的社会福利损失不超过 50 % 50\%。2 2 2 同时，最大化社会福利的 DFS 调度方案可以显著优于 𝒟 ⁡ ( 𝖳 ) \mathcal{D}(\mathsf{T}) 中的任意调度方案。 举个例子，考虑这样一种情况：一个请求的价值为 v ⋆ > 0 v^{\star}>0，且与其他 n − 1 n-1 个请求没有公共前缀；其余每个请求的价值均为 0 0，并共享一个共同前缀。 均匀随机 DFS 调度方案以 1 / 2 1/2 的概率获得零社会福利，而最优 DFS 调度方案则始终能达到最大社会福利 v ⋆ v^{\star}。

paragraphs.en: We now design a welfare-maximizing (or economically efficient ) inference auction that is simple and tractable. In Section 3.1 , we design a scheduling rule that maximizes reported user welfare. The scheduling rule admits a clean algorithm: at every node of the radix tree, visit its children in decreasing order of their average sub-tree bid. In Section 3.2 , we implement VCG prices that incentivize truthful bidding. Although these payments are defined through a separate counterfactual optimization for each user, we show that they can be computed in quasilinear total run-time. Taken together, our scheduling and payment rules maximize true user welfare and can be implemented with very little overhead compared to the time it takes to construct and traverse the radix tree. 3 3 3 Inference frameworks such as SGLang already construct and traverse the radix tree to implement prefix-aware scheduling. We only incur an additional O ⁡ ( log ⁡ ν ) O(\log\nu) multiplicative factor.
paragraphs.zh: 我们现在设计了一种能够最大化福利（或实现经济效率）的推理拍卖机制，该机制既简单又易于处理。 在第 3.1 节中，我们设计了一种调度规则，以最大化用户报告的福利。 该调度规则对应一个简洁的算法：在基数树的每个节点处，按照其子树平均报价的降序访问其子节点。 在第 3.2 节中，我们实现了 VCG 价格机制，以激励真实报价。 尽管这些支付是通过为每位用户单独进行反事实优化来定义的，但我们证明了它们可以在准线性的总运行时间内计算出来。 综合来看，我们的调度规则和支付规则能够最大化用户的真实福利，并且与构建和遍历基数树所需的时间相比，其额外开销极小。3 3 3 像 SGLang 这样的推理框架已经通过构建和遍历基数树来实现前缀感知调度。 我们仅会产生一个额外的 O ⁡ ( log ⁡ ν ) O(\log\nu) 乘性因子。

paragraphs.en: The average-bid DFS of Algorithm 1 yields a schedule that maximizes reported welfare, but our ultimate goal is to maximize welfare with respect to users’ true values. Vickrey [48] - Clarke [13] - Groves [24] (VCG) payments ensure this property by charging each user for the welfare loss that his bids impose on the other users. When paired with a scheduling rule that maximizes reported welfare over a fixed set of feasible outcomes, these payments make truthful bidding (i.e., bidding 𝐛 i = 𝐯 i \mathbf{b}_{i}=\mathbf{v}_{i} ) an optimal strategy for users with quasilinear utility. We instantiate the VCG mechanism with average-bid DFS schedules and 𝒟 ⁡ ( 𝖳 ) \mathcal{D}(\mathsf{T}) as the feasible set:
paragraphs.zh: 算法 1 的平均报价深度优先搜索（DFS）会产生一个能最大化报告福利的调度方案，但我们的最终目标是最大化基于用户真实价值的福利。 Vickrey [48] - Clarke [13] - Groves [24]（VCG）支付机制通过让每位用户为其报价对其他用户造成的福利损失进行补偿，从而确保了这一特性。 当这些支付机制与一种在固定可行结果集合上最大化报告福利的调度规则相结合时，对于具有拟线性效用的用户而言，真实报价（即报价 𝐛 i = 𝐯 i \mathbf{b}_{i}=\mathbf{v}_{i}）将成为最优策略。 我们将 VCG 机制具体化为使用平均报价深度优先搜索（DFS）调度方案，并以 𝒟 ⁡ ( 𝖳 ) \mathcal{D}(\mathsf{T}) 作为可行结果集合：

paragraphs.en: Efficient Payment Computation. Naively computing VCG payments for each user consists of repeatedly zeroing out that user’s bids and rerunning Algorithm 1 . This approach takes O ⁡ ( m ​ n ​ log ⁡ ν ) O(mn\log\nu) time, which is quadratic in n n if each user has only a single request. While such a quadratic dependence on n n is unavoidable if the goal is to return the welfare-optimal DFS traversal when each user is excluded, we are able to bypass this barrier since we only need the optimal welfare values. As a result, our algorithm enjoys an improved runtime of O ⁡ ( min ⁡ { M , m ​ n } ​ log ⁡ ν ) O(\min\{M,mn\}\log\nu) .

paragraphs.en: The key idea behind our algorithm (Appendix B.2 ) is easiest to see when each user submits a single request. Suppose we set the bid of request r r to zero. At every internal node on the path from the root to r r ’s leaf, only the average bid of the child containing r r changes. This average can only decrease, and so the affected child can only move later in the welfare-optimal traversal while all other children retain their relative order. Siblings that remain on the same side of the affected child do not contribute to the user’s payment, while each sibling that overtakes it contributes a local externality. Since the children are already sorted by average bid from the average-bid DFS schedule, a binary search identifies the siblings that overtake the affected child. Summing these local effects via pre-computed prefix sums over the root-to-leaf path then gives the user’s VCG payment.
paragraphs.zh: 我们算法（附录 B.2）的核心思想，在每个用户仅提交单个请求时最容易理解。 假设我们将请求 r r 的出价设为零。 在从根节点到 r r 叶节点路径上的每个内部节点处，只有包含 r r 的子节点的平均出价会发生变化。 该平均值只会下降，因此受影响的子节点在福利最优遍历中的位置只能靠后移动，而其他所有子节点的相对顺序保持不变。 仍位于受影响子节点同一侧的兄弟节点不会计入用户的支付，而每个超越它的兄弟节点则会贡献一个局部外部性。 由于子节点已根据平均出价按平均出价深度优先搜索调度排序，因此通过二分查找即可确定哪些兄弟节点会超越该受影响的子节点。 随后，通过对根到叶路径上预先计算的前缀和进行求和，即可得出用户的 VCG 支付金额。

paragraphs.en: When a user submits multiple requests, zeroing out all of his bids may affect multiple children of a given internal node. However the same principle still applies: jointly reorder the affected children according to their modified average bids and merge them with the unchanged children.

paragraphs.en: The VCG mechanism makes truthful bidding optimal within any single scheduling batch. However, inference users typically have many requests that need to be served over time, and they may have a budget allocated for the total amount they can spend in a given time period. This budget constraint couples the user’s bids, as bidding truthfully in every batch can exhaust the budget too early. Motivated by autobidding systems in online advertising, 5 5 5 See Section 6 for more background in autobidding in ad auctions. we develop an autobidding agent for inference auctions: an online policy that converts a user’s values and remaining budget into bids, without requiring a model of future demand or competing bids.
paragraphs.zh: VCG机制使得在任何单个调度批次中，真实出价都是最优选择。 然而，推理用户通常有许多需要随时间逐步处理的需求，并且他们可能为特定时间段内可花费的总金额设定了预算限制。 这种预算约束会将用户的各轮出价相互关联，因为在每个批次中都真实出价可能导致预算过早耗尽。 受在线广告中自动出价系统的启发，5 5 5 更多有关广告拍卖中自动出价的背景信息请参见第6节。我们开发了一种用于推理拍卖的自动出价智能体：一种在线策略，它无需预测未来需求或竞争对手的出价模型，即可将用户的价值偏好和剩余预算转化为具体出价。

paragraphs.en: The proof proceeds via a reduction to Balseiro et al. [9] , who study online allocation problems with generic concave reward functions and resource constraints. paragraphs.en: Welfare Under Heterogeneous Pacing. When multiple autobidders pace independently, their multipliers can differ, and so their bids will generally not be proportional to a common pacing factor. This can lead to a loss in per-batch social welfare compared to the welfare under truthful reporting. We now quantify this loss as a function of the request radix tree’s structure.
paragraphs.zh: 异质节奏下的社会福利。 当多个自动出价者独立调整节奏时，它们的乘数可能不同，因此它们的出价通常不会与一个共同的节奏因子成正比。 与真实报告情况下的社会福利相比，这可能导致每批社会福利的下降。 我们现在将这种损失量化为请求根树结构的函数。

paragraphs.en: Theorem 4.4 isolates the economically relevant source of inefficiency from value pacing in inference auctions. Pacing dispersion only matters when it changes the average-bid ordering of sibling subtrees, and the loss in welfare is weighted by 1 / κ 𝗎 1/\kappa_{\mathsf{u}} . Heterogeneous request-level pacing may therefore be harmless when it “averages out” within subtrees; what matters more is any systematic pacing variation across sibling subtrees that directly compete for scheduling priority. See Figure 7 for an example.
paragraphs.zh: 定理 4.4 将推理拍卖中与经济相关的低效率来源与价值节奏问题区分开来。 只有当节奏分散改变了兄弟子树的平均出价顺序时，它才会产生影响，而福利损失则按 1 / κ 𝗎 1/\kappa_{\mathsf{u}} 进行加权。 因此，当异构请求级节奏在子树内部“被平均化”时，可能不会造成危害；更为关键的是兄弟子树之间任何系统性的节奏差异，这些差异会直接竞争调度优先级。 参见图 7 了解示例。

paragraphs.en: Experiment Setup. We evaluate our algorithm as a layer on top of the SGLang [ 52 ] inference system across several semi-synthetic workloads, on a single 80GB H100 serving a 32B LLM [ 15 ] . We assume the server is saturated: a waiting queue holds Q = 1024 Q=1024 queries, which we split into batches of n n before ordering with our algorithm. When n ≠ Q n\neq Q we do not flush the KV cache in between batches. We configure SGLang to process queries first-come-first-served to preserve their order.
paragraphs.zh: 实验设置。 我们在一个单台 80GB H100 服务器上，针对多个半合成工作负载，将我们的算法作为 SGLang [52] 推理系统的上层模块进行评估，该服务器用于服务一个 32B LLM [15]。 我们假设服务器已饱和：一个等待队列中持有 Q = 1024 个查询，我们在使用算法排序前，将这些查询划分为大小为 n 的批次。 当 n ≠ Q 时，我们不在各批次之间刷新 KV 缓存。 我们将 SGLang 配置为按“先到先得”的顺序处理查询，以保留其原始顺序。

paragraphs.en: Workloads. We construct semi-synthetic workloads from real LLM evaluation data, covering three basic radix tree topologies: stars, chains, and 3-ary trees. For stars, mixshare mixes SQuAD [ 43 ] questions sharing an article as a prefix with GSM8K [ 14 ] questions sharing few-shot examples; in mixshare -P, a P P % of the queries share prefixes and the rest are singletons. For chains we replay SWE-agent [ 50 ] trajectories. For trees, we run tree-of-thought [ 51 ] in a short variant and a long variant over articles of 3–5k tokens. Prompts are ≈ \approx 1k tokens on stars, 3k on chains, and 160 or 4k on the two tree variants, with 60 60 – 97 % 97\% of tokens shared (Appendix D.2 ). The model’s weights leave a 23k-token KV cache; the short trees fit in the cache entirely and serve as a control, while the other workloads force cache eviction.
paragraphs.zh: 工作负载。 我们从真实的 LLM 评估数据中构建半合成工作负载，涵盖三种基本的基数树拓扑结构：星型、链型和三叉树。 对于星型结构，mixshare 将共享一篇文章作为前缀的 SQuAD [43] 问题与共享少样本示例的 GSM8K [14] 问题混合；在 mixshare -P 中，有 P% 的查询共享前缀，其余为单例。 对于链型结构，我们重放 SWE-agent [50] 的执行轨迹。 对于树型结构，我们在长度为 3–5k 个词符的文章上运行 tree-of-thought [51] 的短变体和长变体。 提示在星型结构中约为 \approx 1k 个词符，在链型结构中为 3k 个词符，而在两种树型变体中分别为 160 或 4k 个词符，其中 60%–97% 的词符是共享的（附录 D.2）。 模型的权重会保留一个 23k 词符的 KV 缓存；短树型结构可以完全容纳在缓存中并作为对照，而其他工作负载则会强制触发缓存驱逐。

paragraphs.en: Prefix-Aware LLM Serving. Modern LLM serving frameworks improve request throughput via continuous batching and efficient management of the KV cache. vLLM [ 34 ] uses ideas from virtual memory and paging to reduce KV cache fragmentation. SGLang [ 52 ] stores requests in a radix tree and uses longest prefix matching to increase cache reuse across requests. Preble [ 45 ] jointly optimizes prefix reuse and load balancing across multiple GPUs, while BatchLLM [ 53 ] groups requests with common prefixes offline and coordinates their execution. Dexter et al. [17] study optimal request scheduling under a certain arrival pattern when cached requests are stored in a radix tree, and they propose a new family of scheduling policies which interpolate between first-come-first-served and longest prefix matching. Llumnix [ 46 ] and QoServe [ 22 ] support differentiated latency objectives and request prioritization. Another related line of work studies fairness in LLM serving [ 44 , 11 ] . Our inference auction is the first approach that prioritizes economic efficiency.
paragraphs.zh: 前缀感知型 LLM 服务。 现代 LLM 服务框架通过持续批处理和高效管理 KV 缓存来提升请求吞吐量。vLLM [34] 借鉴了虚拟内存和分页的思想，以减少 KV 缓存的碎片化。 SGLang [52] 将请求存储在基数树中，并利用最长前缀匹配来提高跨请求的缓存重用率。 Preble [45] 联合优化了多个 GPU 上的前缀重用和负载均衡，而 BatchLLM [53] 则离线分组具有共同前缀的请求并协调其执行。Dexter 等人 [17] 研究了在特定请求到达模式下、当缓存请求存储在基数树中时的最优请求调度问题，并提出了一类新的调度策略，该策略在“先到先得”和“最长前缀匹配”之间进行插值。 Llumnix [46] 和 QoServe [22] 支持差异化的延迟目标和请求优先级设置。 另一条相关研究路线探讨了 LLM 服务中的公平性问题 [44, 11]。 我们的推理拍卖方法是首个优先考虑经济效率的方法。

paragraphs.en: Priority Auctions and Queues. The idea of allowing delay-sensitive users to purchase queue priority has a long history [ 32 , 21 , 28 , 37 , 1 , 31 , 29 , e.g.,] . LLM inference differs from these classical models because inference requests are not computationally independent from one another. To the best of our knowledge, our work is the first to design incentive-compatible priority mechanisms for LLM inference serving.
paragraphs.zh: 优先拍卖与队列。 允许对延迟敏感的用户购买队列优先权这一理念历史悠久 [32, 21, 28, 37, 1, 31, 29，例如]。 LLM 推理与这些经典模型不同，因为推理请求之间在计算上并非相互独立的。 据我们所知，我们的工作首次为 LLM 推理服务设计了激励相容的优先机制。

paragraphs.en: Autobidding Agents. Autobidding has been studied extensively in online ad auctions; see Aggarwal et al. [2] for a recent survey. Balseiro and Gur [10] provide an adaptive pacing algorithm which scales bids according to realized expenditure. Balseiro et al. [9] generalize their algorithm to online mirror descent and weaken several theoretical assumptions. Subsequent work studies social welfare and learning dynamics when autobidders interact in repeated ad auctions [ 8 , 16 , 20 , 36 , 39 , 5 , e.g.] . While our pacing autobidding algorithm is similar to some that are typically used in ad auctions, our welfare guarantees leverage the specific structure of the radix tree and are unique to our LLM inference setting.
paragraphs.zh: 自动出价智能体。 在线广告拍卖中已对自动出价进行了广泛研究；近期综述请参见 Aggarwal 等人 [2]。 Balseiro 和 Gur [10] 提出了一种自适应节奏算法，该算法会根据实际支出调整出价。Balseiro 等人 [9] 将其算法推广到在线镜像下降法，并放宽了若干理论假设。 后续研究探讨了当自动出价者在重复广告拍卖中互动时，社会福利和学习动态的变化 [8, 16, 20, 36, 39, 5, 例如]。 虽然我们的节奏控制型自动出价算法与广告拍卖中常用的一些算法相似，但我们的社会福利保证利用了基数树的具体结构，并且仅适用于我们的 LLM 推理场景。

paragraphs.en: LLMs and Incentives. Our results are broadly related to the growing body of work at the intersection of game theory, mechanism design, and generative AI. Chen et al. [12] , Guo et al. [25] , and Liu et al. [35] study pricing and incentives for LLM routing, while Harris et al. [27] and Anagnostides et al. [4] design incentive-aware credit assignment schemes for AI-generated content. Velasco et al. [47] study social inefficiency resulting from model providers’ incentives to increase test-time compute in order to increase revenue; they propose having model providers bid in a reverse second-price auction to resolve this inefficiency. There is also a line of work which designs auctions for ad placements in LLM-generated text [ 19 , 18 , 26 ] . Finally, Ji et al. [30] also combine an inference system with auction design in the context of distributed computing; specifically, procuring edge devices for speculative decoding.

paragraphs.en: We design the first inference auction , a mechanism for allocating LLM serving capacity during times of high request volume. Our inference auction enjoys the following key properties: (1) forcing the winning schedule to be a DFS schedule ensures cache optimality, (2) welfare maximization corresponds to a simple DFS comparator that orders radix subtrees by average bid, and (3) VCG payments, which incentivize truthful bidding, can be implemented with negligible computational overhead. We also design a pacing autobidder that learns how to bid in repeated inference auctions under a budget constraint. Our autobidder dynamically adjusts bids based on realized spending, and achieves sublinear regret relative to the optimal-in-hindsight bidding policy. When users in a batch run pacing autobidders independently, we bound the resulting welfare loss by the differences in the effective pacing factors of sibling subtrees. In experiments, our inference auction improves social welfare while retaining the caching and latency advantages of SGLang. Our work demonstrates how economic objectives can be incorporated directly into LLM serving infrastructure without sacrificing performance.
paragraphs.zh: 我们设计了首个推理拍卖机制，用于在高请求量时期分配大型语言模型（LLM）的服务容量。 我们的推理拍卖具备以下关键特性：（1）强制获胜调度方案为深度优先搜索（DFS）调度，可确保缓存最优性；（2）社会福利最大化对应一个简单的 DFS 比较器，该比较器按平均出价对基数子树进行排序；（3）VCG 支付能够激励真实出价，且其计算开销可忽略不计。 我们还设计了一种调速自动出价器，它能在预算约束下学习如何在重复的推理拍卖中进行出价。 我们的自动出价器会根据实际支出动态调整出价，并实现了相对于事后最优出价策略的次线性遗憾。 当一个批次中的用户独立运行调速自动出价器时，我们将由此产生的社会福利损失限制在兄弟子树的有效调速因子差异之内。 实验表明，我们的推理拍卖在保持 SGLang 的缓存和延迟优势的同时，提升了社会福利。 我们的工作展示了如何将经济目标直接整合到大型语言模型服务基础设施中，而无需牺牲性能。

paragraphs.en: There are several exciting directions for future research. Serving large-scale systems may require joint orchestration of auctions, request routing, and cache management across multiple inference workers. Support for richer latency preferences is also an interesting direction. Finally, collusion-proof inference auction design is important to prevent strategic coordination across users.
paragraphs.zh: 未来研究有几个激动人心的方向。 运行大规模系统可能需要跨多个推理工作节点，对拍卖、请求路由和缓存管理进行联合协调。 支持更丰富的延迟偏好也是一个有趣的方向。 最后，设计防串通推理拍卖对于防止用户之间的策略性协调至关重要。

paragraphs.en: The Clarke [13] pivot term h i ​ ( 𝐛 − i ) h_{i}(\mathbf{b}_{-i}) in VCG payments is often (informally) framed as the maximum welfare the bidders excluding i i could obtain when bidder i i is removed from the auction, while we define it by zeroing out that bidder’s bids. In typical multi-item multi-bidder auction settings, there is no distinction. In our setting, actually evicting i i ’s requests would alter the radix tree of requests and change the ground set of feasible schedules to allow requests to go un-served. In addition to the fact that all requests should eventually be served, a payment scheme based on eviction would incur outward payments made by the system to the users. Indeed, any zero-bidder would have to be paid because the maximum welfare enjoyed by the remaining bidders decreases when that zero-bidder is evicted, since each remaining bidder would win lower fractional priority.
paragraphs.zh: 在 VCG 支付中，Clarke [13] 枢轴项 h_i(\mathbf{b}_{-i}) 通常（非正式地）被表述为：当排除智能体 i 后，其他竞标者能够获得的最大福利；而我们的定义则是将该智能体的所有出价置零。 在典型的多个物品、多个竞标者的拍卖设定中，二者并无区别。 在我们的设定中，实际移除智能体 i 的请求会改变请求的基数树，并调整可行调度方案的基本集合，从而导致某些请求无法被服务。 除了所有请求最终都必须被服务这一要求外，基于移除机制的支付方案还会导致系统向用户支付额外费用。 事实上，任何出价为零的智能体都必须获得支付，因为当该出价为零的智能体被移除时，其余竞标者所能获得的最大福利会下降，因为每位剩余竞标者赢得的分数优先级都会降低。

paragraphs.en: The framework of Balseiro et al. [9] requires (1) a convex and bounded action set that contains a “do nothing” action, (2) nonnegative, bounded, concave rewards, and (3) nonnegative, bounded resource consumption. To obtain the required action set, we first subtract the priority received by a zero bid, which is independent of the autobidder’s report, and consider only additional priority. For any fixed auction instance, the finitely many feasible schedules induce a finite menu of priority-and-payment outcomes. Allowing randomization over this menu produces a bounded and convex action set with zero as a feasible option, as well as nonnegative and bounded expected utility. Under VCG, the autobidder’s paced bid selects exactly the menu option that maximizes incremental utility after penalizing its payment by the current budget multiplier. Thus, the two algorithms coincide until the remaining budget is no greater than the largest possible payment. Finally, the randomized hindsight benchmark is at least as strong as our original deterministic benchmark in Definition 4.1 . ∎
paragraphs.zh: Balseiro 等人提出的框架。 [9] 要求：(1) 一个包含“不采取任何行动”选项的凸且有界的动作集合；(2) 非负、有界且凹的奖励；以及 (3) 非负且有界的资源消耗。 为了获得所需的动作集合，我们首先减去零出价所获得的优先级（该优先级与自动出价器的报告无关），并仅考虑额外的优先级。 对于任何固定的拍卖实例，有限数量的可行调度会生成一个有限的优先级与支付结果组合集。 在该组合集上允许随机化，可以得到一个有界且凸的动作集合，其中“零”是一个可行的选项，同时期望效用也是非负且有界的。 在 VCG 机制下，自动出价器的分步出价会精确选择这样一个组合集选项：在按当前预算乘数惩罚其支付后，能使增量效用最大化。 因此，这两种算法在剩余预算不超过最大可能支付额之前都会保持一致。 最后，随机化事后基准至少与定义 4.1 中我们最初提出的确定性基准一样有效。∎

sents.en: To obtain the required action set, we first subtract the priority received by a zero bid, which is independent of the autobidder’s report, and consider only additional priority.

sents.en: Allowing randomization over this menu produces a bounded and convex action set with zero as a feasible option, as well as nonnegative and bounded expected utility.
sents.zh: 在该组合集上允许随机化，可以得到一个有界且凸的动作集合，其中“零”是一个可行的选项，同时期望效用也是非负且有界的。

sents.en: Under VCG, the autobidder’s paced bid selects exactly the menu option that maximizes incremental utility after penalizing its payment by the current budget multiplier.

sents.en: Thus, the two algorithms coincide until the remaining budget is no greater than the largest possible payment.
sents.zh: 因此，这两种算法在剩余预算不超过最大可能支付额之前都会保持一致。

sents.en: Finally, the randomized hindsight benchmark is at least as strong as our original deterministic benchmark in Definition 4.1 . ∎

paragraphs.en: Let τ \tau be the stopping time used by Balseiro et al. [9] , namely the first round after which cumulative spending is within C ​ K CK of the total budget T ​ γ T\gamma . For every t ≤ τ t\leq\tau , minimality of the stopping time implies that B ( t ) > C ​ K B^{(t)}>CK . Because ‖ α ( t ) ​ 𝐯 1 ( t ) ‖ 1 ≤ C ​ K < B ( t ) \|\alpha^{(t)}\mathbf{v}_{1}^{(t)}\|_{1}\leq CK<B^{(t)} in every round t ≤ τ t\leq\tau , both Algorithm 3 and Algorithm 1 in Balseiro et al. [9] therefore execute the menu item induced by α ( t ) ​ 𝐯 1 ( t ) \alpha^{(t)}\mathbf{v}_{1}^{(t)} , incur the same payment, and perform the same dual update in every round through τ \tau . The proof of Theorem 1 in Balseiro et al. [9] bounds regret by the primal-dual gap accumulated through τ \tau , together with a term C ​ K ​ 𝔼 ​ [ T − τ ] CK\mathbb{E}[T-\tau] accounting for the remaining rounds. The former depends only on the algorithms’ behavior through τ \tau , while their stopping-time bound controls the latter. Since rewards are nonnegative, the rewards earned after τ \tau may be discarded when lower-bounding Algorithm 3 ’s total reward. Thus the algorithms need not coincide after τ \tau . All assumptions for Theorem 1 in Balseiro et al. [9] now hold, and so translating it into our notation gives the desired regret guarantee. Finally, it is worth noting that the guarantees of Balseiro et al. [9] are with respect to an adversary optimizing over 𝒴 \mathcal{Y} . However the convexified hindsight benchmark can only be larger than the deterministic hindsight optimum, so this bound holds in our setting as well.

paragraphs.en: We use SGLang v0.5.17 9 9 9 https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang serving DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B in bf16 with the engine’s defaults, except that we fix its static memory fraction at 0.85 0.85 , which leaves a 23k-token KV cache. Prefix caching and LRU eviction are handled by SGLang. Every query decodes at most 128 tokens, so TTFT is dominated by prefill and caching. The queue in front of the server holds Q Q queries, splits them into Q / n Q/n batches, orders each batch with one of our algorithms, and sends them sequentially without pausing the engine. The cache is cleared once per experiment (not between batches). The queue sends about 20 queries per second and the engine serves 3 to 4, so the engine’s own queue has a few hundred entries for the whole run; TTFT is almost entirely time spent waiting in the queue (in the order we sent). The queue tokenizes prompts with the model’s tokenizer, so the tree it optimizes is the same one built by SGLang.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用 SGLang v0.5.17 9 9 9 https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang，以 bf16 格式运行 DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B，并采用引擎的默认设置，但将其静态内存比例固定为 0.85 0.85，从而保留 23k 个标记的 KV 缓存。 前缀缓存和 LRU 淘汰由 SGLang 处理。 每次查询最多解码 128 个标记，因此 TTFT 主要由预填充和缓存决定。 服务器前的队列包含 Q Q 次查询，将其分为 Q / n Q/n 个批次，使用我们的算法之一对每个批次进行排序，然后连续发送，而不停止引擎运行。 每次实验结束后会清空一次缓存（批次之间不清空）。 队列每秒发送约 20 次查询，而引擎每秒处理 3 到 4 次，因此整个运行过程中引擎自身的队列中仅有数百个条目；TTFT 几乎完全由在队列中等待的时间构成（按我们发送的顺序）。 队列使用模型的词元化器对提示进行词元化，因此其优化的树与 SGLang 构建的树相同。

paragraphs.en: Welfare is measured with respect to the final ordering of queries ranked by TTFT. It agrees with the welfare of the planned average-bid DFS order to within 1.3 % 1.3\% for all results, so we report only the realized value. Raw welfare varies substantially from trial to trial because a heavy-tailed draw puts a different amount of value in the batch each time, and it moves every algorithm together (Figure 9 ), which is why we plot the percentage over 1 2 ​ ∑ r b r \tfrac{1}{2}\sum_{r}b_{r} . Cache hit rate is defined as the number of cached prompt tokens divided by the total number of prompt tokens, as reported by SGLang. All completion times, when reported, record the time from the first send to the last completion of the batch. The queue itself is a Python prototype: for a batch of 1024 1024 queries it computes the order in under a millisecond and the VCG payments in 0.3 0.3 s by naive per-user recomputation (Appendix D.10 has the fast version), while actually serving the batch takes on the order of minutes.
paragraphs.zh: 福利是根据按 TTFT 排序的查询的最终顺序来衡量的。 在所有结果中，该值与计划中的平均出价 DFS 顺序的福利在 1.3%（1.3\%）以内一致，因此我们仅报告实际实现的价值。 原始福利在不同试验中存在显著差异，因为重尾分布每次都会为批次赋予不同的价值，并且这种变化会影响所有算法（图 9），这就是为什么我们将数值绘制为相对于 1/2 ∑_r b_r 的百分比。 缓存命中率定义为已缓存提示词令牌数与提示词令牌总数之比，由 SGLang 报告。 所有完成时间（如报告）均记录从首次发送至批次中最后一个查询完成所花费的时间。 队列本身是一个 Python 原型：对于包含 1024 个查询的批次，它能在不到一毫秒内计算出顺序，并通过简单的逐用户重新计算在 0.3 秒内计算出 VCG 支付（附录 D.10 中有快速版本），而实际处理该批次则需要数分钟时间。

sents.en: All completion times, when reported, record the time from the first send to the last completion of the batch.
sents.zh: 所有完成时间（如报告）均记录从首次发送至批次中最后一个查询完成所花费的时间。

sents.en: The queue itself is a Python prototype: for a batch of 1024 1024 queries it computes the order in under a millisecond and the VCG payments in 0.3 0.3 s by naive per-user recomputation (Appendix D.10 has the fast version), while actually serving the batch takes on the order of minutes.
sents.zh: 队列本身是一个 Python 原型：对于包含 1024 个查询的批次，它能在不到一毫秒内计算出顺序，并通过简单的逐用户重新计算在 0.3 秒内计算出 VCG 支付（附录 D.10 中有快速版本），而实际处理该批次则需要数分钟时间。

paragraphs.en: mixshare mixes three kinds of queries: SQuAD questions, 32 per article, with the article as a shared prefix; GSM8K questions over one of 12 few-shot prefixes; and singletons that share only a short instruction. In mixshare -P, P % P\% of the queries belong to one of the shared prefix clusters. agent replays logged SWE-agent trajectories, where each call’s prompt is the history up to that call, so call k k is a prefix of call k + 1 k+1 . tot replays tree-of-thought on GSM8K (3-ary thought trees of depth 3). tot-long is the same, with a SQuAD article of 3-5k tokens as the root of every tree; since each thought is a single sentence, nearly every token of every prompt is the article, which is why its shared prefixes are so long and its unique suffixes so short. Table 2 gives the tree statistics of one Q = 1024 Q=1024 instance of each and Figure 8 the per-query distributions. Note the third column of the table: every workload but tot exceeds the KV cache several times over.
paragraphs.zh: mixshare 混合了三种类型的查询：每篇文章包含 32 个 SQuAD 问题，且文章作为共享前缀；基于 12 个少样本前缀之一提出的 GSM8K 问题；以及仅共享简短指令的独立查询。 在 mixshare -P 中，P% 的查询属于共享前缀簇之一。agent 会重演已记录的 SWE-agent 轨迹，其中每次调用的提示词为截至该次调用的历史内容，因此第 k 次调用是第 k+1 次调用的前缀。tot 则对 GSM8K 进行思维树推理（深度为 3 的三叉思维树）。tot-long 的做法相同，但每棵树的根节点是一篇包含 3-5k 个词元的 SQuAD 文章；由于每个思维步骤仅为一句话，因此几乎每个提示词中的词元都来自该文章，这也是其共享前缀极长而唯一后缀极短的原因。 表 2 展示了每种方法在 Q = 1024 的一个实例中的树结构统计信息，图 8 则显示了每类查询的分布情况。 注意表格的第三列：除 tot 外，所有工作负载都使 KV 缓存的使用量超出了其容量的数倍。

paragraphs.en: Figure 9 gives the raw welfare and TTFT behind the first two columns of Figure 1 . In the sharing sweep at n = 256 n=256 , nothing can be cached at P = 0 P=0 and the algorithms differ only through the order itself. As P P grows, the completion time of the two DFS orders falls from about 560 s to 330 s while that of bid-sort and no-sort rises to 740 s. In the batch-size sweep on mixshare -50, no-sort does not depend on n n by construction, which is a useful consistency check; for dfs-bid , the hit rate goes from 0.23 0.23 at n = 32 n=32 to 0.60 0.60 at n = Q n=Q and mean TTFT from 316 s to 160 s. The ratio of the best DFS welfare to the unconstrained optimum falls gently with sharing, from 0.83 0.83 at P = 0 P=0 to 0.78 0.78 at P = 75 % P=75\% , as deeper trees hit the DFS restriction more often. While one might expect dfs-bid and bid-sort to agree at P = 0 P=0 , singletons in our dataset contain a very short shared instruction, causing us to serve one group before another.
paragraphs.zh: 图9给出了图1前两列背后的原始福利和TTFT值。 在 n = 256 的共享扫描中，当 P = 0 时无法缓存任何内容，各算法的差异仅体现在顺序本身。 随着 P 的增长，两种DFS顺序的完成时间从约560秒降至330秒，而bid-sort和no-sort的完成时间则升至740秒。 在mixshare-50上的批量大小扫描中，根据构造，no-sort不依赖于 n；这是一个有用的一致性检查。对于dfs-bid，命中率从 n = 32 时的0.23升至 n = Q 时的0.60，平均TTFT则从316秒降至160秒。 最佳DFS福利与无约束最优值的比率随着共享而缓慢下降，从 P = 0 时的0.83降至 P = 75% 时的0.78，因为更深的树更容易受到DFS限制的影响。 虽然人们可能预期dfs-bid和bid-sort在 P = 0 时结果一致，但我们数据集中的单元素包含一个非常短的共享指令，导致我们先处理一组再处理另一组。

paragraphs.en: Figures 10 , 11 , and 12 vary the batch size on different radix tree topologies: chains, short trees, and long trees. On chains at n = Q n=Q , dfs-bid beats dfs-uniform by 16 % 16\% at the same hit rate and TTFT, while bid-sort wins welfare by 48 % 48\% and pays with a 0.48 0.48 hit rate (versus dfs-bid ’s 0.75 0.75 ) and 2.4 × 2.4\times the TTFT. no-sort and bid-sort have the same hit rate at every n n , since sorting a random order by bid leaves it random from the cache’s point of view. Short trees fit in the cache, so nothing is evicted. Here, every algorithm has the same 28 s TTFT. Long trees are where the DFS restriction of our inference auction has the largest impact. dfs-bid keeps a 0.96 0.96 hit rate and a 46 s TTFT, and bid-sort drops to 0.20 0.20 and 559 s, because every branch it interleaves recomputes a 4k-token prefix.
paragraphs.zh: 图 10、11 和 12 在不同基数树拓扑结构（链式树、短树和长树）上改变了批量大小。 在 n = Q 的链式树上，当命中率与 TTFT 相同时，dfs-bid 比 dfs-uniform 快 16%；而 bid-sort 的福利提升 48%，但命中率为 0.48（相比之下，dfs-bid 的命中率为 0.75），TTFT 则为 2.4 倍。no-sort 和 bid-sort 在每个 n 值下的命中率都相同，因为从缓存的角度来看，按出价对随机顺序进行排序并不会改变其随机性。 短树可以完全装入缓存，因此没有任何内容被驱逐。 在此情况下，所有算法的 TTFT 均为相同的 28 秒。 长树正是我们的推理拍卖中 DFS 限制影响最大的情况。dfs-bid 保持了 0.96 的命中率和 46 秒的 TTFT，而 bid-sort 则降至 0.20 和 559 秒，因为它在交错处理的每个分支中都需要重新计算一个包含 4k 个标记的前缀。

paragraphs.en: The main results draw bids i.i.d. per query, which is the case of many users sharing a prefix with unrelated values and the hardest case for dfs-bid . To interpolate toward the case where one user owns a whole cluster, we draw values from a Gaussian copula with within-cluster correlation ρ \rho and the same Pareto marginal. A cluster is a set of queries sharing at least 128 prefix tokens on stars, a trajectory on chains, and a tree on trees; singletons are unaffected. Each cluster c c draws Z c ∼ 𝒩 ⁡ ( 0 , 1 ) Z_{c}\sim\mathcal{N}(0,1) and each query r r in it draws ϵ r ∼ 𝒩 ⁡ ( 0 , 1 ) \epsilon_{r}\sim\mathcal{N}(0,1) ; its value is v r = 1 + ( 1 − Φ ( z r ) ) − 1 / 1.5 v_{r}=1+(1-\Phi(z_{r}))^{-1/1.5} with z r = ρ ​ Z c + 1 − ρ ​ ϵ r z_{r}=\sqrt{\rho}\,Z_{c}+\sqrt{1-\rho}\,\epsilon_{r} . So ρ = 0 \rho=0 is i.i.d. and ρ = 1 \rho=1 gives every query in a cluster the same value.
paragraphs.zh: 主要结果中，每次查询都独立同分布地抽取出价；这种情况适用于许多用户共享前缀但具有无关值的场景，也是 dfs-bid 最难处理的案例。 为了向单个用户拥有整个集群的情况进行内插，我们从具有簇内相关系数 ρ 和相同帕累托边缘分布的高斯相依变量中抽取值。 一个簇是共享至少 128 个前缀标记的查询集合：在 stars 结构中为共享前缀，在 chains 结构中为共享轨迹，在 trees 结构中为共享树结构；单元素查询不受影响。 每个簇 c 都抽取 Z_c ∼ 𝒩(0,1)，其中每个查询 r 都抽取 ϵ_r ∼ 𝒩(0,1)；其值为 v_r = 1 + (1 − Φ(z_r))^{-1/1.5}，且 z_r = √ρ·Z_c + √(1−ρ)·ϵ_r。 因此，当 ρ = 0 时，各查询独立同分布；而当 ρ = 1 时，簇中的每个查询都具有相同的值。

paragraphs.en: Figure 13 plots welfare against ρ \rho on stars and the right column of Figure 1 displays the engine results at ρ ∈ { 0 , 0.5 , 1 } \rho\in\{0,0.5,1\} . dfs-bid gains as ρ \rho grows because the value-sorted order and the tree-contiguous order agree more often: the best DFS welfare rises from 0.83 0.83 to 0.91 0.91 of the unconstrained optimum. bid-sort does not gain, and it still thrashes the cache at ρ = 0.5 \rho=0.5 (hit rate 0.29 0.29 against 0.60 0.60 ). At ρ = 1 \rho=1 its order happens to keep clusters together and its hit rate matches dfs-bid ’s, but dfs-bid is still faster (mean TTFT 85 s against 124 s), because it serves short high-value clusters first.
paragraphs.zh: 图 13 绘制了福利与 ρ \rho 在星形结构上的关系，而图 1 的右列展示了当 ρ ∈ { 0 , 0.5 , 1 } \rho\in\{0,0.5,1\} 时引擎的运行结果。随着 ρ \rho 增大，dfs-bid 的性能有所提升，因为按价值排序的顺序与树状连续顺序的一致性更高：最佳 DFS 福利从 0.83 0.83 上升到了无约束最优值的 0.91 0.91。而 bid-sort 并未获得提升，并且在 ρ = 0.5 \rho=0.5 时仍然导致缓存频繁失效（命中率仅为 0.29 0.29，远低于 0.60 0.60）。 当 ρ = 1 \rho=1 时，其排序恰好能保持簇的完整性，且命中率与 dfs-bid 相当，但 dfs-bid 仍然更快（平均 TTFT 为 85 秒，对比 124 秒），因为它会优先处理短而高价值的簇。

paragraphs.en: Figure 14 repeats this experiment on chains and long trees at n = Q n=Q . On long trees at ρ = 1 \rho=1 the two optima coincide: dfs-bid reaches 0.999 0.999 of the unconstrained welfare at the same hit rate and TTFT as bid-sort . On chains it reaches 0.90 0.90 , and the remaining gap is the cost of the DFS restriction when trajectories on the same task share interior nodes with other users. On both, bid-sort recovers the cache only at ρ = 1 \rho=1 ; at ρ = 0.5 \rho=0.5 its TTFT is still 2 × 2\times dfs-bid ’s on chains and 10 × 10\times on long trees.
paragraphs.zh: 图 14 在 n = Q 的情况下，对链和长树重复了这一实验。 在 ρ = 1 的长树上，两个最优解重合：dfs-bid 在相同的命中率和 TTFT 下，达到了无约束福利水平的 0.999。 在链上，该值达到 0.90，而剩余的差距则源于 DFS 限制所带来的成本，即当同一任务上的轨迹与其他用户共享内部节点时所产生的代价。 在这两种结构中，bid-sort 仅在 ρ = 1 时才能恢复缓存；而在 ρ = 0.5 时，其 TTFT 在链上仍为 dfs-bid 的 2 倍，在长树上则为 10 倍。

sents.en: On long trees at ρ = 1 \rho=1 the two optima coincide: dfs-bid reaches 0.999 0.999 of the unconstrained welfare at the same hit rate and TTFT as bid-sort .
sents.zh: 在 ρ = 1 的长树上，两个最优解重合：dfs-bid 在相同的命中率和 TTFT 下，达到了无约束福利水平的 0.999。

sents.en: On chains it reaches 0.90 0.90 , and the remaining gap is the cost of the DFS restriction when trajectories on the same task share interior nodes with other users.
sents.zh: 在链上，该值达到 0.90，而剩余的差距则源于 DFS 限制所带来的成本，即当同一任务上的轨迹与其他用户共享内部节点时所产生的代价。

sents.en: On both, bid-sort recovers the cache only at ρ = 1 \rho=1 ; at ρ = 0.5 \rho=0.5 its TTFT is still 2 × 2\times dfs-bid ’s on chains and 10 × 10\times on long trees.
sents.zh: 在这两种结构中，bid-sort 仅在 ρ = 1 时才能恢复缓存；而在 ρ = 0.5 时，其 TTFT 在链上仍为 dfs-bid 的 2 倍，在长树上则为 10 倍。

paragraphs.en: We consider now a situation similar to that of the highest-correlation setting of the experiments in Figures 13 and 14 (though in the original setting of i.i.d. Pareto bids). We draw one cluster of queries with a shared prefix at random among the clusters with at least eight members (32 to 58 queries on these instances). That cluster keeps its Pareto bids. Every other bid is set to zero (Figure 3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们现在考虑一种与图 13 和图 14 中实验的最高相关性设置类似的情况（尽管原始设置是独立同分布的帕累托出价）。 我们从至少包含八个成员的簇中随机抽取一个具有共享前缀的查询簇（在这些实例中，这些查询簇包含 32 到 58 个查询）。 该簇保留其帕累托出价。 所有其他出价均设为零（图 3）。

sents.en: We consider now a situation similar to that of the highest-correlation setting of the experiments in Figures 13 and 14 (though in the original setting of i.i.d. Pareto bids).
sents.zh: 我们现在考虑一种与图 13 和图 14 中实验的最高相关性设置类似的情况（尽管原始设置是独立同分布的帕累托出价）。

sents.en: We draw one cluster of queries with a shared prefix at random among the clusters with at least eight members (32 to 58 queries on these instances).
sents.zh: 我们从至少包含八个成员的簇中随机抽取一个具有共享前缀的查询簇（在这些实例中，这些查询簇包含 32 到 58 个查询）。

sents.en: That cluster keeps its Pareto bids.
sents.zh: 该簇保留其帕累托出价。

sents.en: Every other bid is set to zero (Figure 3 ).
sents.zh: 所有其他出价均设为零（图 3）。

paragraphs.en: This bid distribution is meant to model a realistic scenario where most users do not submit any bid for priority (such users still participate in the auction and must be served in a timely fashion).
paragraphs.zh: 这种出价分布旨在模拟一个现实场景：大多数用户不会为优先权提交任何出价（但这类用户仍会参与拍卖，并且必须得到及时服务）。

paragraphs.en: Serving the cluster with non-zero bids first corresponds to both the unconstrained optimum and a DFS order, so dfs-bid matches bid-sort ’s welfare at every where the paying cluster gets its first tokens in about a second under either algorithm. The margin over the bid-blind algorithms grows with n n , from nothing at n = 32 n=32 , where a batch rarely holds more than one or two members of the cluster, to about 100 100 points at n = Q n=Q . dfs-bid ’s hit rate and completion time equal dfs-uniform ’s at every n n , while bid-sort ’s hit rate stays near 0.25 0.25 and its TTFT is about 1.5 × 1.5\times at every n n above 32 32 .
paragraphs.zh: 首先用非零出价服务集群既对应于无约束最优解，也对应于深度优先搜索（DFS）顺序，因此，在任何情况下，dfs-bid 的福利都与 bid-sort 相同，因为付费集群在两种算法下大约在一秒内就能获得第一批代币。 相对于 bid-blind 算法的优势会随着 n 的增长而扩大：当 n = 32 时，这种优势几乎不存在，因为一个批次通常只包含集群中的一两个成员；而当 n = Q 时，这一优势可达约 100 分。在每一个 n 值下，dfs-bid 的命中率与完成时间都等于 dfs-uniform，而 bid-sort 的命中率始终接近 0.25，其 TTFT 在大于 32 的每个 n 值下都约为 1.5 倍。

paragraphs.en: The main protocol has the whole queue present at t = 0 t=0 , so the batch-size sweep in Figure 1 shows the benefit of a larger batch but not its cost (the wait for the batch to fill). Here the 1024 1024 queries of mixshare -50 arrive as a Poisson process at 4 or 1 per second, a batch is released when its n n -th query arrives, and TTFT is measured from arrival. no-sort is batched the same way, so the batching cost is common to all algorithms. Table 3 reports means over three trials.
paragraphs.zh: 主协议在 t = 0 时已包含整个队列，因此图 1 中的批量大小扫描展示了更大批量的优势，但并未体现其代价（即等待批量填满的时间）。 在此，mixshare -50 的 1024 个查询以泊松过程的形式到达，每秒 4 或 1 个；当第 n 个查询到达时，该批量即被释放，TTFT 从查询到达时刻开始计时。no-sort 也以相同方式分批次处理，因此批量处理的代价对所有算法都是相同的。 表 3 报告了三次试验的平均值。

sents.en: The main protocol has the whole queue present at t = 0 t=0 , so the batch-size sweep in Figure 1 shows the benefit of a larger batch but not its cost (the wait for the batch to fill).
sents.zh: 主协议在 t = 0 时已包含整个队列，因此图 1 中的批量大小扫描展示了更大批量的优势，但并未体现其代价（即等待批量填满的时间）。

sents.zh: 在此，mixshare -50 的 1024 个查询以泊松过程的形式到达，每秒 4 或 1 个；当第 n 个查询到达时，该批量即被释放，TTFT 从查询到达时刻开始计时。no-sort 也以相同方式分批次处理，因此批量处理的代价对所有算法都是相同的。

sents.en: Table 3 reports means over three trials.
sents.zh: 表 3 报告了三次试验的平均值。

paragraphs.en: At 4 queries per second the server is saturated: the queue arrives in about 250 s and takes over 500 s to serve. Going from n = 64 n=64 to n = 512 n=512 adds 55 s of batch wait but changes dfs-bid ’s mean TTFT by between − 7 -7 and + 29 +29 s across trials, because the added wait mostly replaces time the query would have spent waiting in the engine, while the hit rate rises from 0.33 0.33 to 0.56 0.56 . The same change costs no-sort 100 s and buys it nothing. At 1 query per second the server keeps up with arrivals, there is no queue to hide the wait, and n = 512 n=512 costs about 280 s of TTFT. Under load a large batch is nearly free; under light load a timeout should release batches long before they fill.
paragraphs.zh: 在每秒 4 次查询的负载下，服务器达到饱和：队列大约需要 250 秒才能形成，而处理这些请求则需要超过 500 秒。 将 n 从 64 增加到 512，会使批量等待时间增加 55 秒，但不同试验中 dfs-bid 的平均 TTFT 变化范围在 -7 到 +29 秒之间，这是因为增加的等待时间主要取代了查询原本在引擎中等待的时间，同时命中率从 0.33 上升到了 0.56。 同样的变化对 no-sort 而言既没有节省任何时间，也没有带来任何好处。 在每秒 1 次查询的负载下，服务器能够跟上请求到达的速度，不存在隐藏等待时间的队列，而 n = 512 会使 TTFT 增加约 280 秒。 在高负载下，大批量处理几乎不产生额外成本；而在低负载下，超时机制应该会在批量处理完成之前很久就将其释放。

paragraphs.en: Table 4 repeats our main experiments with Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct [ 42 ] in place of the 32B model, on the same instances and with the KV cache capped at the same number of tokens. The two models share a tokenizer, so the trees are identical. Welfare agrees to the unit in every experiment and hit rates are very similar; time metrics are smaller due to the smaller size of the model.
paragraphs.zh: 表 4 重复了我们的主要实验，其中用 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct [ 42 ] 替代了 32B 模型，并在相同的实例上运行，同时 KV 缓存的上限也保持相同的令牌数。 这两个模型共享同一个分词器，因此它们的树结构完全相同。 在所有实验中，福利指标与单位保持一致，命中率也非常相似；由于模型规模更小，时间指标也更小。

paragraphs.en: Figure 15 repeats the mixshare -50 and chains experiments at n = Q n=Q with bids pulled from different distributions, namely uniform and lognormal. The cache hit rate and TTFT does not change, since they depend on the tree and not on the bids. dfs-bid ’s gain over dfs-uniform is positive and significant under every distribution and grows with the tail, as does bid-sort ’s gain over dfs-bid .
paragraphs.zh: 图 15 重复了 mixshare -50 和 chains 在 n = Q n=Q 时的实验，其中出价来自不同的分布，即均匀分布和对数正态分布。 缓存命中率与 TTFT 并未改变，因为它们取决于树结构而非出价。在所有分布下，dfs-bid 相对于 dfs-uniform 的优势均为正值且显著，并随尾部增长而增大；bid-sort 相对于 dfs-bid 的优势同样如此。

paragraphs.en: The experiments compute payments by rerunning the allocation once per user, which incurs a quadratic run-time. We also implemented the algorithm of Theorem 3.3 , which re-sorts only the affected children on a user’s root-to-leaf paths. Its payments agree with the naive computation to 10 − 12 10^{-12} on random trees and on our stored instances, and at n = 1024 n=1024 it takes 34 ms while the naive algorithm takes 370 ms on average.
paragraphs.zh: 这些实验通过为每个用户重新运行一次分配来计算支付，这会带来二次运行时间。 我们还实现了定理 3.3 中的算法，该算法仅对用户在根到叶路径上受影响的子节点进行重排序。 在随机树和我们存储的实例中，其计算结果与朴素计算的差异不超过 10^{-12}；当 n = 1024 时，该算法平均耗时 34 毫秒，而朴素算法平均需要 370 毫秒。

sents.zh: 我们还实现了定理 3.3 中的算法，该算法仅对用户在根到叶路径上受影响的子节点进行重排序。

paragraphs.en: We simulate Algorithm 3 over T = 60 T=60 batches of n = 256 n=256 . For stars, each shared-prefix cluster belongs to a distinct user. For chains, each trajectory belongs to a distinct user. Half the users pace toward a target spend of half their mean truthful payment with step size η = 0.1 \eta=0.1 normalized by the target; the rest bid truthfully. Figure 16 shows the usual behavior of dual descent with a fixed step: spend runs above the target while the multiplier is small and below it once the multiplier has grown. Welfare under pacing averages 0.91 0.91 of the DFS optimum at true values on stars and 0.93 0.93 on chains, and the bound of Theorem 4.4 holds in every batch.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 T = 60 个批次（每批 n = 256）上模拟算法 3。 对于星型结构，每个共享前缀簇属于一个不同的用户。 对于链式结构，每条轨迹属于一个不同的用户。 一半的用户以步长 η = 0.1（经目标值归一化）向目标支出值调整，该目标值为其真实支付均值的一半；其余用户则按真实值出价。 图 16 展示了固定步长下双重下降法的典型行为：当乘子较小时，支出值高于目标值；一旦乘子增长，支出值则低于目标值。 在星型结构中，考虑真实值时，调整策略下的社会福利平均为 DFS 最优值的 0.91；在链式结构中则为 0.93，且定理 4.4 中的界在每个批次中都成立。

sents.en: Welfare under pacing averages 0.91 0.91 of the DFS optimum at true values on stars and 0.93 0.93 on chains, and the bound of Theorem 4.4 holds in every batch.
